title: 真实OAuth2双请求链：分别修复token和webhook信任及代理，验证scope拒绝与过期刷新
answer:
```python
import copy
def repair_transport(config,hook_ca,token_ca,hook_proxy,token_proxy):
    result=copy.deepcopy(config)
    rows=[r for r in result["receivers"] if r["name"]=="private"]
    if len(rows)!=1 or len(rows[0].get("webhook_configs",[]))!=1:raise ValueError("one approved private webhook required")
    http=rows[0]["webhook_configs"][0]["http_config"]
    http["tls_config"]={"ca_file":hook_ca,"insecure_skip_verify":False}
    http["proxy_url"]=hook_proxy
    http["oauth2"]["tls_config"]={"ca_file":token_ca,"insecure_skip_verify":False}
    http["oauth2"]["proxy_url"]=token_proxy
    return result
```

原题知识说明：
先把获取令牌与发送通知画成两条独立HTTP链：前者使用http_config.oauth2中的client_id、client_secret_file、token_url、scopes，以及该OAuth2块内的tls_config和代理设置；后者使用外层http_config的TLS与代理设置访问Webhook，并携带获得的访问令牌。不能假定外层CA或代理会自动满足token端点，也不能把client secret当Bearer token发送给业务服务。目标版本需支持所用字段，并遵守oauth2与basic_auth/authorization互斥的约束；此处是机器client credentials流程，不依赖浏览器回调或用户授权码。交付字段到连接的对应表、两端证书身份/信任根、允许出口及scope合同。隔离验收分别让token端点不可达、其证书错误、scope被拒、Webhook证书错误及令牌到期，使用两端脱敏请求日志区分拿不到令牌与拿到令牌后通知被拒；还须验证正常刷新后继续发送。秘密只能流向授权端点，令牌仅用于目标资源。任一信任链或scope未经确认即停止上线，恢复已验证配置并保持失败可观测，不关闭证书验证或无限延长令牌寿命。交付的是方案与验收设计，未执行生产操作。

## 操作任务
实现repair_transport(config,hook_ca,token_ca,hook_proxy,token_proxy)：深拷贝配置，必须恰有一个name=private接收器且恰有一个webhook，否则ValueError。只修复它http_config的tls_config={ca_file:hook_ca,insecure_skip_verify:false}、proxy_url=hook_proxy，以及http_config.oauth2内部的tls_config={ca_file:token_ca,insecure_skip_verify:false}、proxy_url=token_proxy。其他字段和原输入不变；client_id/client_secret_file/token_url/scopes、Webhook URL、路由、分组和通知时序均不可变，不添加basic_auth/authorization，不关闭校验。题给路径和代理经独立审批，两个CA彼此独立，两个回环CONNECT代理各只允许其授权目的端口。真实Alertmanager分别经历token代理拒绝、token证书不受信、错误scope及业务证书不受信，均应失败且不被业务端接受；修复后client secret只向令牌端点认证，Bearer仅向业务端点，令牌实际过期后重新取令牌继续投递。交付代码和字段归属说明；负例与正常刷新由真实原生进程验收，日志不得含测试秘密或令牌。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
官方Alertmanager0.28.1 Windows原生进程，Python私有HTTPS OAuth client-credentials与资源服务器，两张临时自签根证书及两个限制目的地的真实CONNECT代理。使用一次性测试凭据和短寿命令牌，真实TLS信任拒绝、HTTP scope拒绝、令牌过期刷新及Webhook投递均验证；不是企业IAM/OAuth产品认证、生产代理或外部通知验收。CA仅通过题定文件传入，不安装宿主信任根，不修改系统代理/身份/时间，不构建镜像。题目没有原独立故障编号，故障注入只是此题验收，不新增故障完成量。

import copy,json,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,sys,tempfile,time
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/"checks"))
import task
from oauth_fixture import Fixture,native,send,wait_for,failed
binary=shutil.which("alertmanager") or shutil.which("alertmanager.exe")
assert binary and "0.28.1" in subprocess.check_output([binary,"--version"],stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=5)
print("NATIVE_PLATFORM_READY",flush=True)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="opsforge-oauth-chains-") as temp:
 root=pathlib.Path(temp);fixture=Fixture(root)
 try:
  def http(c):return c["receivers"][0]["webhook_configs"][0]["http_config"]
  def countercase(name,change,verify,diagnostic):
   c=fixture.config();change(c);nt=len(fixture.token_requests);nh=len(fixture.hook_requests);np=len(fixture.proxy_events)
   with native(root/name,c) as base:
    send(base,name);wait_for(lambda:diagnostic in (root/name/"native.log").read_text(encoding="utf8",errors="replace"));assert len(fixture.hook_requests)==nh
    verify(nt,np)
  fixture.token_proxy_denied=True
  countercase("TokenUnreachable",lambda c:None,lambda nt,np: (len(fixture.token_requests)==nt and any(x["chain"]=="token" and not x["allowed"] for x in fixture.proxy_events[np:])) or (_ for _ in ()).throw(AssertionError("token denied proxy witness absent")),"Forbidden")
  fixture.token_proxy_denied=False
  def bad_token_ca(c):http(c)["oauth2"]["tls_config"]["ca_file"]=fixture.hook_ca
  def no_token(nt,np):
   assert len(fixture.token_requests)==nt and any(x["chain"]=="token" and x["allowed"] for x in fixture.proxy_events[np:])
  countercase("TokenWrongCA",bad_token_ca,no_token,"x509")
  def bad_scope(c):http(c)["oauth2"]["scopes"]=["forbidden"]
  def scope_denied(nt,np):assert len(fixture.token_requests)>nt and not fixture.token_requests[-1]["scope_valid"] and fixture.token_requests[-1]["client_valid"]
  countercase("TokenWrongScope",bad_scope,scope_denied,"invalid_scope")
  def bad_resource_ca(c):http(c)["tls_config"]["ca_file"]=fixture.token_ca
  def token_but_no_resource(nt,np):
   assert len(fixture.token_requests)>nt and fixture.token_requests[-1]["scope_valid"]
   assert any(x["chain"]=="resource" and x["allowed"] for x in fixture.proxy_events[np:])
  countercase("ResourceWrongCA",bad_resource_ca,token_but_no_resource,"x509")
  print("NATIVE_OAUTH_TOKEN_PROXY_DENIED_TOKEN_CA_SCOPE_AND_RESOURCE_CA_SEPARATELY_FAILED_NO_RESOURCE_ACCEPTANCE",flush=True)
  broken=fixture.config();http(broken)["tls_config"]["ca_file"]=fixture.token_ca;http(broken)["proxy_url"]=fixture.token_proxy
  http(broken)["oauth2"]["tls_config"]["ca_file"]=fixture.hook_ca;http(broken)["oauth2"]["proxy_url"]=fixture.hook_proxy
  unchanged=copy.deepcopy(broken)
  print("STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: repair actual OAuth token and resource TLS/proxy chains",flush=True)
  fixed=task.repair_transport(broken,fixture.hook_ca,fixture.token_ca,fixture.hook_proxy,fixture.token_proxy)
  nt=len(fixture.token_requests);np=len(fixture.proxy_events)
  with native(root/"StudentFixed",fixed) as base:
   send(base,"FirstApproved")
   wait_for(lambda:any(x["payload"]["alerts"][0]["labels"]["alertname"]=="FirstApproved" for x in fixture.hook_requests))
   first=next(x for x in fixture.hook_requests if x["payload"]["alerts"][0]["labels"]["alertname"]=="FirstApproved")
   time.sleep(max(0,fixture.tokens[first["token"]]-time.monotonic()+.2))
   assert fixture.tokens[first["token"]]<time.monotonic()
   send(base,"AfterActualTokenExpiry")
   wait_for(lambda:any(x["payload"]["alerts"][0]["labels"]["alertname"]=="AfterActualTokenExpiry" for x in fixture.hook_requests))
   second=next(x for x in fixture.hook_requests if x["payload"]["alerts"][0]["labels"]["alertname"]=="AfterActualTokenExpiry")
   assert second["token"]!=first["token"] and len(fixture.token_requests)>=nt+2
   assert {x["chain"] for x in fixture.proxy_events[np:] if x["allowed"]}=={"token","resource"}
  assert broken==unchanged and fixed==fixture.config(),"only approved transport fields may change; auth/scopes/URLs/routes stay"
  for log in root.glob("*/native.log"):
   text=log.read_text(encoding="utf8",errors="replace")
   assert fixture.secret not in text and all(token not in text for token in fixture.tokens)
  assert fixture.hook_denied==0
  print("NATIVE_OAUTH_TWO_DISTINCT_CA_AND_PROXY_CHAINS_CLIENT_SECRET_TOKEN_ONLY_BEARER_RESOURCE_ONLY_ACTUAL_EXPIRY_REFRESH_AND_REDELIVERY",flush=True)
 finally:fixture.close()
print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)
